text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. You start from command given from control room, i.e DCs,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: typically 24V which typically stays for around 1 sec

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Understand that any K11, K12, K20 contactor setup we have two parts,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A. Relay, B. Contact.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and these relays some operate with AC, some do with DC, and some both AC and DC

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and when they say particular relay say K12 is NO contact, that means, when we give AC/DC

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: supply to that relay, the main contact in that shall make to close (without supply it was Open contact)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: in technical terms they say, K12 is NO to NC - Normally open to Normally Close.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: there's a spring provision in that K12 which will make the contact to original NO(open circuit)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: when supply removed from the K12, so Simply to say, K12 is NO - open circuit by default, and gets close

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: i.e. NO turns to NC with supply AC/DC

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. And typically, the relay shall be given lower voltage supply and the contact of that shall MAKE/BREAK higher

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: voltage, like sending 24V DC to relay, shall make 110V AC supply. and so on, however this is typical, not always.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. This DCS command shall make a control supply of 110V AC that is taken from that particular switchgear

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: via control transformer, typically, the 3 phase supply from every switchgear tapped as single phase and that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: shall be given to typically two transformers called control transformer, from which 110V control supply

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is taken, and used. This ensures that control supply can only go away only if the 3 phase

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to the switchgear is gone, in which case drive shall not have 3ph, and so no bother about

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: control supply too.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Steps to understand:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. when we give command from DCS, it goes to K12 relay, and this makes the contact, as

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: here K12 is NO contact, and this makes NO to NC for around a second and gets back to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: NO again.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. This making shall send 110V control supply, FIG-1, to here main contactor A1,A1 coil.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Now this A1,A2 is a standard called coil, this relay pick MAKES 3 ph supply of drive.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Now to break the supply to drive also, similar way : FIG-2, you give stop command to DCS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and this will activate K11 relay, and K11 relay is NC relay, so with 24V DC command, the contact

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: BREAKS 110V supply to A1,A2 coil and so as A1,A2 coil gets deactivated, -it-Main contactor - gets back to its NO

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: hence the 3 ph supply gets break.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Now one problem is as the DCS shall be only for around 1 sec, however for the 3 ph supply through

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: main contactor is continously needed, the main contactor shall have to be in activated position

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: continuosly, so we use a trick, what we do is, we shall have another contact in Main contactor, which

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is also NO, which shall NOT make 3 phase supply, instead it makes the supply to it's own i.e. 110V

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: control supply so, as the 110V control supply to main contactor relay MAKE the contact, the relay

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: stays activated, and so contact stays MADE. - FIG-3

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: So bottom line is with command, K12 acts, then so Main contactor acts, and so, Main contact(3 ph)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and Aux contact both gets MAKE(NO to NC), and though K12 gets to its default of NO,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: main contactor shall stay MAKE, due to Aux contact.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. To stop the drive, simply break the 110V control supply to main contactor, which we do as shown in FIG-4 way,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: by making act K11 relay, NC to NO, and so breaks the supply.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: tripped or not, if tripped by Overload - OLR or the NO contact

g.text: in parellel with OLR NO is process trip, both shall act K2

g.text: contactor, and with K2 contactor, the contacts taken shall

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: make and show trip indication.

g.text: K1- is the main contactor as we discussed earlier - contact used for Off indication. if K1 not acted, it shows OFF

g.text: because pressing EPB shall directly cut off control supply of main contact K1
